limitations: One camera location, synthetic market/combat populations, and this K620 only.
Frame cap removes recurring long frames in these tests; exact uncapped scheduling/driver cause remains unresolved.
Crowd comparison changes the complete preset (textures,scale,shadows,body budget), not body count alone; priority bodies can exceed configured cap.
